title.en: A counter arm makes salad: washing alone, cutting with a person nearby

goal.en: The counter arm washes, cuts under its camera, whisks and mixes. Washing may run alone; the knife may not, even when the camera verifies every cut.

note.en: Nobody home: the two washing steps are planned, then cutting is refused.
A person nearby: the arm does seven of nine steps; the cuts are verified by its camera; chilling and serving are the person's.
The camera is a rung for cutting even with nobody present. The ladder verifies the cut; the envelope's unattended rule is what requires the person.

outcome.en: You know what an arm on the counter can do while you are out (wash) and what waits for you (anything with a blade). Verification and presence are two separate rules.
